outcome: Proteomic profile of human amniotic mesenchymal stem cells (hA-MSCs)
Involvement of proteins in stress response pathways
Involvement of proteins in cytoskeleton pathways
Involvement of proteins in metabolic pathways
cohort: The study included human amniotic mesenchymal stem cells (hA-MSCs) obtained from 12 obese and 6 non-obese women at delivery by cesarean section.
finding: The study found 62 differently expressed proteins in hA-MSCs from obese mothers compared to non-obese mothers, involved in stress response, cytoskeleton, and metabolic pathways, suggesting a reduced stress response in hA-MSCs from obese mothers.
mod_finding: All human amniotic mesenchymal stem cells (hA-MSCs) were obtained from women at delivery by cesarean section.
